Upstream file: package/dist/rapier.cjs (WASM is embedded as base64)

Vendored rapier.js SHA-256: DA0A81DC64391098AE6A8D12472D643286120F973C6D721A7DCBA034FEA91FAC

The vendored script contains the upstream rapier.cjs code unchanged except for
its final sourceMappingURL comment. A small wrapper supplies a local `exports`
object and assigns it to globalThis.RAPIER and, when present, module.exports.
This makes the same file a browser classic script and a Node CommonJS module.

To reproduce, run `npm pack @dimforge/rapier3d-compat@0.21.0`, extract the
resulting tarball, and use package/dist/rapier.cjs. Remove only the final
`//# sourceMappingURL=rapier.cjs.map` line. Prepend the license header and
wrapper lines at the start of rapier.js, up to and including `var exports = {};`.
Append the two wrapper lines after the upstream body, beginning with
`return exports;`. Copy package/LICENSE to RAPIER-LICENSE.txt. Compare the
SHA-256 hashes above after generation.

Usage: load rapier.js with `<script src="vendor/rapier.js"></script>` and
call `await window.RAPIER.init()` before using the physics classes. In Node,
`const RAPIER = require('./dist/vendor/rapier.js')` and then
`await RAPIER.init()`.
